name: Next.js + Keycloak RBAC
postStartCommand: apk add --no-cache nginx 2>/dev/null; KC_HOST=${CODESPACE_NAME:+${CODESPACE_NAME}-8080.${GITHUB_CODESPACES_PORT_FORWARDING_DOMAIN:-app.github.dev}}; KC_HOST=${KC_HOST:-localhost:8080}; printf "server{listen 8080;location/{proxy_pass http://keycloak:8080;proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto https;proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Host ${KC_HOST};proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Port 443;proxy_set_header Host \$host;proxy_buffer_size 128k;proxy_buffers 8 128k;}}" > /etc/nginx/http.d/kc.conf && rm -f /etc/nginx/http.d/default.conf && nginx -t && nginx && echo "nginx → ${KC_HOST}" && cd /workspace && npm run dev
